content: jsonschema 4.26.0 (PyPI, 2026-01-07): full Draft 2020-12 support. API: jsonschema.validators.validator_for(schema) returns Draft202012Validator when $schema absent (latest draft default); Draft202012Validator(schema).iter_errors(instance) yields ValidationError objects carrying .json_path, .absolute_path, .validator, .message; check_schema validates the schema itself.
